title: Natural comparison of etale module cohomology with underlying abelian cohomology
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and $\Lambda$ a commutative ring. Let $S$ forget a $\Lambda$-module valued sheaf on the small etale site to an abelian sheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and let $U:\mathrm{Mod}(\Lambda)\to\mathrm{Ab}$ forget coefficients. For every $q\geq0$, there is a natural isomorphism $U\circ H^q_\Lambda(Y,-)\cong H^q_{\mathrm{Ab}}(Y,-)\circ S$, with cohomology defined by [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] on sheaves placed in degree zero. No qcqs or filtered-colimit hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: The coefficient forgetful functor is exact: restriction along Z to Lambda is left adjoint to coextension and right adjoint to extension, composed with the integer-module/abelian-group equivalence. Its induced sheaf functor is both left and right adjoint by the site sheafification adjunction, hence exact as well.

Evaluate at the terminal identity etale object. Evaluation commutes definitionally with coefficient forgetting. The two Sheaf.GammaNatIsoSheafSections isomorphisms give the natural isomorphism Gamma_modules composed with forget to sheafForget composed with Gamma_abelian.

Apply the source library Functor.isIso_rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange_of_rightAcyclic to this isomorphism, using underlying injective acyclicity for its hypothesis. Thus the plus-derived base-change transformation is an isomorphism. Unfolding Functor.rightDerivedBaseChange shows that its classical-degree-q transformation is also an isomorphism: all its factors are whiskered isomorphisms.

Use the source library rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility and singleFunctorCompRightDerivedFunctorPlusCompHomologyFunctorIso for each coefficient category to compare classical right derived global sections with the precise unbounded Etale.cohomology on degree-zero sheaves. Whisker and compose these natural isomorphisms with the classical base-change isomorphism. This gives the claimed natural isomorphism.
